title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical errors visible; the stated properties are the standard ones (cf. Bourbaki, Intégration VII §1 no. 2) and are correct as stated.

ideas.what: Existence of Haar measure via covering numbers (f:g) and their properties (i)-(vii)
ideas.modern_name: Haar measure; Haar–Weil construction with Haar covering numbers
ideas.usually_credited_to: Haar (1933), von Neumann, Weil (1940); this exposition is Bourbaki, Intégration ch. VII (1963)
ideas.where_published: Bourbaki, Éléments de mathématique, Intégration, Chap. VII, §1, no. 2 (collective Bourbaki text, not Grothendieck's)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a recycled Bourbaki typescript draft of the standard Haar measure existence proof, used as scrap paper. It has no connection to the motivic notes on adjacent pages and contains nothing new. Its only interest is archival: it is evidence that Grothendieck wrote on the backs of Bourbaki rédactions, here no. 370, Intégration VII.
transcription_corrections: The image is upside down (rotated 180°); the transcription correctly reads it in the proper orientation.
This is a typed Bourbaki rédaction (n°370, page 6), not Grothendieck manuscript notes; the '225' is the archive page number.
gamma(s) denotes left translation (Bourbaki's γ(s)), consistent with the transcription.
